quiz.question: What is the primary goal of this project?
options: To design and implement an AI-powered software system

quiz.question: What are the core capabilities that the system must support?
options: Import and process documents from at least 3 different file types
Users must be able to interact with the selected corpus through AI-powered, retrieval-grounded workflows
Users must be able to influence generation through customizable prompts or parameters
Documents, metadata, and generated artifacts must persist between application runs
quiz.correct_answer: Import and process documents from at least 3 different file types

quiz.question: What are the two engineering challenges that each team must select?
options: Implement and compare at least two retrieval strategies
Iteratively improve prompts for a specific task
Generate an interactive visualization derived from the corpus
quiz.correct_answer: Implement and compare at least two retrieval strategies

quiz.question: What are the allowed uses of AI in this project?
options: Learn, design, debug, implement, test, document
Generate the entire system or large components in one step
quiz.correct_answer: Learn, design, debug, implement, test, document

quiz.question: What is the expected deliverable for this project?
options: A runnable web application running locally on the user's machine
A GitHub repo with source code, documentation, and instructions to run the application locally
A technical report in the REPORT.md file
